mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are overcast at Harriet Park with a temperature of 71 degrees and a Waxing Crescent moon visible in the sky.
Looking at our inbox and city reports, there are no new updates or important emails to share with you this morning.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, and the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the annual UGM event at Epic Systems and yoga at Insight Wellness.
There are no incidents to share from the Verona Police Department's weekly report.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
